notes.title: Degeneration Update Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

We are happy to being with you with our new update. We belive that Degeneration became more enjoyable and more easy to play now. 
What have we changed;

-We realized that puzzles of shopping mall is too complicated. So new version of it is much easer and much focused on story instead of complicated puzzles. 

-We have added "New game" and "Continue" buttons on main menu.

-A few optimization problems are solved.

-We have removed some unusual gameplay mechanics.

Have a nice day :)
